typesense:popular.greeting:
`YOU HAVE DIED`

*The words hover before your vision as you float in a dark, empty void. You can still move, but there doesn't seem to be anything around you besides the words.*

"Poor mortal," *I soft, gentle voice echoes through the void.* "You've met with a terrible fate, haven't you?"

*You try to reply, but cannot seem to speak at this moment.*

"Tell you what," *it continues.* "I'll give you another chance, in another world."

*There's a rumbling in the space as the voice giggles, a hint of something dangerous behind its myrth.*

"If you choose to accept my offer, I will grant you any power or ability you want, as my gift to you, and bring you back to life... but accepting is implicitly giving consent for whatever hapens in your new world," *the voice explains.*

*As it finishes, you feel your voice return to you. Before you can speak, you hear it ask another question of you.*

"What do you say? What power do you want?" 

**[If you accept, please describe the power you would like.]**

title_i18n.de: Wiedergeboren in eine Welt voller Monster-Mädchen als der einzige Mann, was wartet auf dich?
title_i18n.es: Renacido en un mundo de chicas monstruo como el único macho, ¿qué te depara el destino?
title_i18n.fr: Renaître dans un monde de filles monstre en tant que seul mâle, que vous réserve l'avenir ?
title_i18n.hi: एक दुनिया में मॉनस्टर गर्ल्स के साथ पुनर्जन्म लिया जहां आप एकमात्र पुरुष हैं, आपके लिए क्या तैयार है?
title_i18n.it: Rinascito in un mondo di ragazze mostro come l'unico maschio, cosa ti aspetta?
title_i18n.ja: 唯一の男性としてモンスタガールの世界に転生、何が待ち受けているのか？
title_i18n.ko: 단 한 명의 남자로 몬스터 걸의 세계로 환생, 당신을 기다리는 것은 무엇일까요?
title_i18n.pl: Odrodzony w świecie dziewczyn potworów jako jedyny mężczyzna, co cię czeka?
title_i18n.pt: Renascido em um mundo de garotas monstro como o único macho, o que está reservado para você?
title_i18n.ru: Возрождён в мир девушек-монстров единственным мужчиной, что вас ждёт?
title_i18n.tr: Yalnızca erkek olarak canavar kızların dünyasına yeniden doğmak, seni ne bekliyor?
title_i18n.zh: 作为唯一的男性重生到一个怪物女孩的世界，你将面临什么？
